leadIn: After completing this lesson, you will be able to:
objectives: Implement a Redux slice using createSlice to manage local state in an Angular service
Configure async actions with createAsyncThunk to handle API data fetching
Integrate Redux Toolkit actions with Angular component event handlers
Manipulate state within reducers to update application data
Initialize the Redux store with configured slices in an Angular application
Bind component properties to Redux state using selectors
Control loading and error states during async operations
